BiblicalUsage: Marçᵉnâʼ is Marsena, one of the seven princes of Persia and Media. In Esther 1:14 he stands next to the king, among those who saw the king's face and sat first in the kingdom. The name is a single line in a court list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Marsena shows me that God names even the princes who sit near a king, and that no court is outside His sight.
